units.source_text: 果然，这一封子在棋友之间和社会上议论纷纷，成了话题。

en.t: Sure enough, this move was hotly discussed among Go enthusiasts and in society at large, and became a topic of conversation.

units.source_text: 在这个地方下黑121，我们这些外行人确是感到诧异和突然，心里也很不舒服。

en.t: For amateurs like us, playing Black 121 at this point truly felt surprising and abrupt, and it also left us very uneasy.

units.source_text: 然而，后来在专业棋手中，也有人认为在这里下黑121是适时的、有效的。

en.t: However, later on, among professional players, some also believed that playing Black 121 here was timely and effective.
